title: Cognition is not confined to brains

statements.text: Cognition is not confined to brains: cells, tissues and other non-neural systems process information and pursue goals, with no bright line between cognition and mere physics.

Bodies consist of components which are themselves competent (goal-seeking modules that navigate their own spaces) and can achieve specific outcomes despite perturbations and changing conditions.
